test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Paranoid
solution:
The correct answer is '**Distrustful**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Paranoid**' is '**Distrustful**'.
 
• **Paranoid**: wrongly believing that other people are trying to harm you or are saying bad things about you. (इस मिथ्‍या संदेह से ग्रस्‍त कि अन्‍य लोग हानि पहुँचाना चाहते हैं या दुर्व्यवहार कर रहे हैं)
 
 
• *Example: I guess I was just being **paranoid**. *
 
 
 
• **Distrustful**: feeling or showing distrust of someone or something. (किसी या किसी चीज़ के प्रति अविश्वास महसूस करना या दिखाना)
 
 
• *Example: I have grown up to be **distrustful** of men.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Distrustful.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Trustful**: having or marked by a total belief in the reliability, truth, or ability of someone. (किसी की विश्वसनीयता, सच्चाई या क्षमता में पूर्ण विश्वास होना या होना)
 
• **Convinced**: completely sure about something. (किसी विषय में पूर्णतया आश्‍वस्‍त)
 
• **Committed**: prepared to give a lot of your time and attention to something because you believe it is right or important. [(किसी उचित या महत्वपूर्ण लगने वाले कार्य में) संलग्‍न, प्रतिबद्घ]
